scope: Local pinned Temporal toolchain qualification only. This review does not accept B03 application workflows, business behavior, production Temporal, or original acceptance tests.

archive_integrity.validation: The archive has exactly the six declared entries. Every member's independently computed byte count and SHA-256 matches h1-verification.json. Its normalized JUnit has exactly the five expected IDs and zero failures, errors, or skips; the public JUnit hostname attribute is absent.

temporal_history_and_duplicate_policy.run_id_publication: sha256 only; raw value remains private
temporal_history_and_duplicate_policy.running_and_closed_duplicates: Both raw client outputs show WorkflowAlreadyStartedError, typed-error flag true, and the original run ID.
temporal_history_and_duplicate_policy.history: Privately retained phase1 and phase2-before histories are byte-identical and have the same four ordered events. The full phase2-after event objects preserve that prefix and end with WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_COMPLETED after one finish signal. Reported hashes match the three private history files; private files are mode 0600.

owned_runtime_processes.listeners: Both server phases observed five owned listeners, all bound to loopback.

deadlines.basis: Five private timing records match the five JUnit names; all body and cleanup monotonic boundaries are ordered and within the approved 30/240-second per-case limits and 300-second phase limit.

captured_sources_and_protected_inputs.readme_exception: Current README differs from accepted G6 only by the documented H1 test-ignore and separate H1 runner/lock section; SHA-256 is 0964d4dae840f9a433d88ee92132efedb7e17c77ac815d0e955c6fdbc65c7100.

failed_attempts_and_privacy.private_gate_modes: The final gate directory and every nested directory are mode 0700; all files are mode 0600.
failed_attempts_and_privacy.public_archive: Contains only normalized summary, JUnit, pytest log, runtime summary, relative case timings, and package manifest. It contains no private source ZIP, full histories, SQLite store, raw service/worker/client/exception logs, PID/start ticks, raw run ID, host name, absolute workspace path, or private gate path.
failed_attempts_and_privacy.marker_scan: Independent byte scan found no raw workflow run ID, process PID/start ticks, host name, workspace/gate path, SQLite filename, or worker/client identity in public members. Only the intended run-ID hash and private history filenames/hashes are disclosed.
failed_attempts_and_privacy.raw_private_exceptions: No exception trace is part of the public archive; raw diagnostic/log material remains private.
